title: Brain Cipher Ransomware Group: Victims, Leak Site, TTPs & IOCs
description: Brain Cipher is a financially motivated cybercriminal group operating since the early 2020s, specializing in sophisticated ransomware attacks against large organizations. The group employs double extortion tactics, threatening to release stolen data if ransom demands are not met, with payments typically ranging from $150,000 to $8 million in Monero cryptocurrency. They utilize a modified variant of LockBit 3.0 ransomware and conduct extensive network infiltration and data exfiltration before deployment. Their attack methodology incorporates zero-day vulnerabilities and social engineering techniques to maximize effectiveness. The group has targeted critical sectors including healthcare and finance, demonstrating willingness to disrupt essential services for financial gain, with 76 documented victims across 51 countries.
